text:
anya: Quick idea  dim sum crawl at 12:30 Saturday then optional karaoke at The Nook at 8pm. Family-friendly + daytime walkable. Who's up for both/one? :steam_locomotive: :microphone:

simon: I can do dim sum but not karaoke (early morning flight).

yara: Both for me! Can we try to keep karaoke to 2-3 songs per person so folks can leave early?

henry: I'm in for karaoke only (work Saturday morning). Will show up around 8:15.

leah: I'll bring a stroller-friendly folding seat for the little one. Also vegetarian dim sum recs?

ya: Golden Lotus has great veggie dumplings and a tofu-skin roll.

anya: Plan: meet at lobby 12:20, walk to Golden Lotus for 12:30 seating. Dim sum budget ~ $15-25 each depending on appetite. Karaoke later at The Nook 20:00.

simon: Can we do a quick RSVP? React with :dumpling: for dim sum, :microphone: for karaoke, :hamburger: if you want both, :no_entry_sign: if youre out.

leah: :hamburger:

ya: :hamburger:

henry: :microphone:

simon: :dumpling:

anya: Noted. Allergies? Henry any food restrictions?

henry: No shellfish for me please.

ya: Gluten-free option appreciated.

anya: I'll ask the restaurant to hold a GF steamed menu and mark shellfish on the order. Also reserving table for 7.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Dim Sum Crawl" Sat 12:30  reminder at 10:00. Reminder scheduled: "Karaoke @ The Nook" Sat 20:00  reminder at 17:00.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Dim Sum Crawl + Karaoke (optional)" Sat 12:30  guests updated. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/2501234567

anya: If anyone can take point for napkins/hand sanitizer, reply here. I'll collect cash for dim sum so no one has to split 20 ways at the table.

simon: I'll bring napkins and a small cash envelope.

leah: I'll bring sanitizer and baby wipes.

anya: Quick logistics snippet:
```
- Meet: Lobby 12:20
- Restaurant: Golden Lotus, 12:30 reservation (7 people)
- Budget: ~$15-25 pp
- Karaoke: The Nook 20:00 (optional)
- Allergies: shellfish avoid, GF option requested
```

ya: Yay! See you all Saturday  can someone ping here if the weather looks awful? Might be a rain detour but both venues are indoor so unless transit is bad were good. :umbrella:

anya: Will post final confirmation Friday 6pm. Thanks everyone! :party_popper:
